metadata.scenario: An individual reaches out to a moving company for a quote on their upcoming cross-country relocation. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. Nice to meet you, David! How can I help you today? Well, my wife is recovering from a stroke, and we need some physical therapy and nursing care at home. I’m sorry to hear about your wife. I can definitely help with that. We offer skilled nursing care and physical therapy services that could be beneficial for her recovery. That sounds good. Can you tell me more about the services and pricing? Absolutely! Our skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 per visit, depending on the services required. Physical therapy is priced between $110 and $140 per session. What does each service include? Skilled nursing care includes medication management, wound care, and monitoring health conditions, while physical therapy focuses on mobility, strength, and balance improvement. That makes sense. How often would we need these services? Typically, we recommend at least two to three sessions per week for physical therapy, and nursing visits can be scheduled as needed. I see. Would it be possible to have a nurse evaluate my wife at home? Yes, we can arrange for a nurse to conduct an initial assessment in your home. This will help us create a tailored care plan for her needs. Great! How do we proceed with scheduling this assessment? I can set that up for you. When would be a good time for a visit? Would next Tuesday work? Let me check our availability. Yes, we have openings next Tuesday between 10 AM and 12 PM. Does that work for you? Yes, 10 AM is perfect. Excellent! I’ll book that for you. I’ll also send you some information via email regarding our services and pricing. Thank you, that would be helpful. You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. Great! I look forward to helping you and your wife. If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to call back. I appreciate your help, Margaret. Thank you, David! Have a wonderful day. You too, bye! Goodbye!
